overview: P0 E2E validation for safe run-scoped exports, fail-closed blocked-export UX, and deep-link return to failed-row triage with context intact.
goals: Preserve run scope across export and triage surfaces.
Catch regressions in blocked-export recovery loop.
successMetrics: Blocked runs cannot export and always provide run-scoped failed-row recovery path.
uiNotes: Run selector lists completed runs only.
Blocked-export panel includes deterministic failed-row count and CTA.
Recovery CTA preserves selected run context.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses one completed safe run and one run with verification failures.

rules: Exports are run-scoped and fail closed when verification fails.
Blocked path must provide immediate triage return action.

stories.title: Export Safely and Recover via Failed Rows
stories.description: As an operator, I need export controls to be safe and context-preserving so blocked runs route me directly to the right triage view.
acceptanceCriteria: Given one safe completed run and one blocked run, export selector offers completed runs and scoped export actions.
When selecting a safe completed run, CSV/DOCX export actions succeed with downloadable outputs.
Then selecting a blocked run shows deterministic blocked panel with failed-row CTA preserving run scope.
Example: clicking `Review failed rows` opens report with matching `run_id` and failed filter.
Negative: blocked run must not produce exported file artifacts or silent success state.
